projects.title: To Do App
projects.description: Everyong has built a simple to-do list. This application was first built with AngularJS, because it is rather ancient — but later migrated to AlpineJS which was more lightweight. Designed to fit my second monitor, e.g. a TV that faces outward, so at a glace I and anyone I work with can see my daily progress. Also, sound effects because they're fun.
